Baba,

scroll slowly

I know I’m not always the best at everything, and I know I have my flaws, but there is one thing I know I will always be the best at — loving you.

I promise I’ll take care of you for as long as I live. I promise I’ll be there for you, through every good day and every bad one. I never want to let you feel like you’re alone, because you have me, always. You’re mine, and I’m yours, and honestly, I wouldn’t want it any other way.

From the day I met you at the GBM, I feel like a part of me has been with you. And the time we spent together at the conference is something I know I’ll cherish for the rest of my life.

I still remember holding your hand throughout the gala night, telling you that you were going to get that award, believing in you even before you knew it yourself. And then kissing you for the first time that night — that moment will always have a special place in my heart.

Somehow, you left this imprint on me that I don’t think I could ever shake off, even if I wanted to. You became a part of my life, my thoughts, my happiness, and my heart without me even realizing how deeply you had gotten into it.

Baba, I love you. More than I probably know how to put into words. And I guess this is just my little way of showing you how much you mean to me, how grateful I am for you, and how much I want you to know that I’m here to stay.

I’m yours.
Always.

❤️
